summary: Habbo entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Habbo

primary.why: Habbo is an active online social world, so the archive target is the current official client and account/community state. Habbo Hotel: Origins and Habbo X are separate service branches, not replacements for the main Habbo route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official Habbo web client. Record date, hotel/region, account/avatar, room/item state, client branch, moderation/account restrictions, and whether Origins or Habbo X were checked separately.

secondary.what_to_play: Track separately if documenting the 2005-style client revival.
secondary.why: It is a separate branch with different audience/rules and should not replace main Habbo.

secondary.what_to_play: Skip unless specifically documenting Habbo's Web3 branch.
